description: Shahzad Textile Mills Limited was incorporated in 1978 and describes itself as a vertically integrated yarn and socks manufacturer and exporter based in Lahore. It runs three spinning units with 62,688 spindles producing ring-spun cotton, polyester/cotton and polyester/viscose yarns, and in 2019 added a fully integrated socks and hosiery plant that it says can make 100 million pairs a year. The company markets its yarn under the Britestar, Dynacon and Unicorn brands.
headOffice: Office 701, 7th Floor, Tricon Corporate Center, Jail Road, Gulberg II, Lahore, Pakistan

products.name: Britestar — 100% cotton yarn
products.summary: 100% cotton ring-spun yarn from 15,840 spindles, counts Ne 7/1 to Ne 40/1, for knitting and weaving.

products.name: Dynacon — polyester/cotton yarn
products.summary: Ring-spun PC and CVC yarn from 26,688 spindles in blends including PC 52:48, PC 65:35 and CVC 60:40, carded or combed, counts Ne 7/1 to Ne 45/1.

products.name: Unicorn — polyester/viscose yarn
products.summary: Ring-spun polyester/viscose yarn from 20,160 spindles, counts Ne 7/1 to Ne 65/1, for knitting and weaving.

products.name: Socks and hosiery
products.summary: Socks made at a vertically integrated plant — knitting on Italian Lonati machines, toe closing, dyeing, boarding and packing — with capacity the company puts at 100 million pairs a year.
